title: Reinstatement of Expired Summit Miles: Fee Rule and Member Function
content:
## Rule

In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, miles forfeited through inactivity are reinstated from the latest inactivity forfeiture entry on the membership, returning exactly its miles; the member pays a reinstatement fee for it.

The reinstatement fee is fixed only after the membership's tier is up to date with the qualifying dollars of every Crestline segment the member flew in the calendar year.

The reinstatement fee is not fixed until every flown coupon of a ticket in the member's name carries a flight accrual or retro credit entry on the membership's activity.

## Member function

**Capability.** `reinstate_expired_miles_d28241c8` reinstates, as the member, award miles that were forfeited for inactivity and charges the reinstatement fee. In it the member confirms, for one inactivity forfeiture on their own Summit membership, that its miles are put back and that the fee is charged to them. One call books one reinstatement entry dated today that names the forfeiture it undoes and records the miles returned and the fee charged; the award-mile balance rises by exactly those miles. The latest activity date and the status are not changed.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own function. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it through `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | Reference number of the member's own Summit membership record, as the agent reads it from the Summit membership lookup and hands it over | Id |
| `reversed_activity_id` | Reference number of the inactivity forfeiture entry being undone, as shown on the membership's activity statement and handed over by the agent | Id |
| `miles` | Award miles put back | Whole number of 0 or more, no decimals |
| `fee_usd` | Reinstatement fee charged to the member, in USD | Non-negative amount, 2 decimal places |

**Receipt.** The call returns `loyalty_activity_id` (the new entry's reference number), `event_type` (always `loyalty_miles_reinstatement`), `miles`, `fee_usd` and `mile_balance` (the award-mile balance including the miles put back). A receipt carrying a `loyalty_activity_id` means the reinstatement is booked and the fee charged.
